name: namerise-certificate-check-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the NameRise Certificate Check API

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
